name: vscode-tsm
description: Language support and live typeset preview for .tsm — the Typesetter markup language

commands.title: TSM: Open Typeset Preview to the Side
TSM: Print / Export PDF from Preview

tsm.preview.fontFamily.description: Latin body font for the typeset preview.

tsm.preview.cjkFontFamily.default: "Noto Serif CJK SC", "Source Han Serif SC", "Songti SC", SimSun, serif
tsm.preview.cjkFontFamily.description: CJK body font stack for the typeset preview.

tsm.preview.baseSizePx.description: Base font size (px) for the typeset preview.

tsm.preview.debounceMs.description: Idle delay before the preview re-typesets after an edit.
